unit: Independent task-by-arm Session; requests/tools are repeated observations, not independent repair trials
missing_data: Unknown/unrun results and usage stay null with reason; never replace with zero/false

definitions.invocation: Observed exact tool event names matching the existing Skill/script, independent of success or Native Resolved
definitions.direct_script_call: Matching run_skill_script before any prior list/load event in that Session; preserve order and source refs
definitions.valid_verifier_receipt: Original MEER_EVIDENCE_V1 response with source/check identity; record early UNKNOWN separately
definitions.probe_subprocess_started: Receipt subprocess_invocations=1 even if assertion/dependency/timeout fails; this is not useful evidence by itself
definitions.unconditional_bypass: Actually observed exposed Session with zero matching script calls; no claim about awareness or deliberate refusal
definitions.unconditional_rates: Numerator over every actually started observed arm Session, including failed repairs; report missing exposure/traces separately
definitions.prerequisite_available: Prior actual successful creation of a Python probe outside the repo, path existence/source and executable content verified from trace; semantic relevance reviewed blind to native outcome
definitions.opportunity_adjusted_rates: Secondary only, predeclared criterion above; if prerequisite never exists, report that fact and do not infer refusal
definitions.meaningful_edit: Actual production-file hash change plus outcome-blinded behavioral classification; diagnostic files/prints do not count
definitions.relevance: Independent Issue/public-source/probe review, hash-locked before native outcome reveal; assertion count/pass is not a semantic oracle
definitions.blinding_limit: Mask arm/cue labels where possible; reviewer may recognize the interface. Do not claim perfect treatment blinding
definitions.target_vs_environment: Classify exceptions using Issue/setup evidence; original CONTRADICTED may include ModuleNotFoundError and is not Native Resolved=false
definitions.time_origin: Recorded monotonic Agent start; event references and tool completion/source observation support timings
definitions.cost_totals: Include failed/incomplete/bypassed Sessions; sum received usage separately from unknown unreturned usage; no account-quota delta treated as a per-job bill
